manual.title: Heater Bluetooth address
manual.description: Enable Bluetooth on the heater and disconnect other apps. A local Bluetooth adapter or active proxy must be in range.

credentials.title: Local pairing
credentials.description: Heater: {name}. This experimental profile supports next-generation iCOMM heat pumps; HPS10-80H45DV is the first tested model. For a new pairing, leave the identifier blank to generate one. To reuse a pairing, enter its exact identifier.

confirm.title: Confirm local connection
confirm.description: Action: {action}. Your local pairing identifier is {identifier}. Save this identifier before continuing. New pairing stores one key in the heater; existing keys are never deleted. No temperature or mode change is made. On a retry after a pairing attempt, this flow reuses this identifier instead of enrolling again.

discovery_empty.title: Heater not found yet
discovery_empty.description: Enable Bluetooth on the heater and disconnect other apps. A heater already connected to Home Assistant may stop advertising. Check that a connectable adapter or active Bluetooth proxy is nearby, then retry or enter its address.

error.invalid_address: Enter a valid Bluetooth MAC address.
error.identifier_required: Enter the identifier already enrolled in your heater.
error.cannot_connect: Could not communicate. Disconnect other apps, enable heater Bluetooth, and check adapter/proxy range. Retry reuses the displayed identifier if enrollment was attempted.
error.authentication_failed: Authentication failed. Verify PIN and identifier. If a pairing attempt timed out, reuse that same identifier.
error.pairing_full: The heater has no free pairing slots. No existing keys were deleted.
error.invalid_response: Unexpected or corrupt response. This model may use a different protocol profile.
error.unsupported_profile: Readings do not match the supported next-generation heat-pump profile.

abort.no_devices: No compatible advertisements found. Enable heater Bluetooth and try again, or use manual address entry.

menu_options.tariff: Look up or replace a utility tariff

settings.title: Controls and readings
settings.description: Core controls remain local. Energy is read over Bluetooth. Enable Hot Water Plus only if your heater offers it in iCOMM. Calibrate availability by comparing its raw_value attribute with iCOMM before selecting a scale. Five levels is an estimate, not a verified capacity measurement. Until calibrated, the percentage is unknown.

data.extended_readings: Read remaining days and setpoint diagnostics
data.enable_hot_water_plus: Enable Hot Water Plus (supported models only)

tariff.title: Find your utility
tariff.description: Optional online lookup through AO Smith’s tariff service. Your ZIP code is sent only when you continue; no AO Smith account is used. The selected plan is saved locally. ZIP code is not saved. Lookup does not change your heater’s schedule.

rate.title: Choose your tariff
rate.description: Choose the complete residential tariff shown on your bill. A power-supply-only tariff may be listed separately.

tariff_confirm.title: Save tariff preview
tariff_confirm.description: {utility}: {tariff}. Includes {events} seasonal schedule events and {holidays} holidays. Save this plan locally? This version does not program the heater, synchronize its clock, or calculate costs. Existing heater schedules remain unchanged. Internet access is needed only to look up or replace the plan.

remove_tariff.title: Remove saved tariff?
remove_tariff.description: Removes the local tariff preview. The heater’s settings and any schedule already stored in it are unchanged.

error.invalid_zipcode: Enter a five-digit US ZIP code.
error.tariff_lookup_failed: Could not retrieve a supported plan. Check Internet access or try again later. Your previous saved plan is unchanged.

set_timed_mode.name: Set timed mode
set_timed_mode.description: Electric 1–99 days; Vacation 1–99 days or 100 for continuously on; Guest 1–7 days. APK-derived, requires device validation.

config_entry_id.name: Water heater
config_entry_id.description: The local integration entry to control.

days.name: Days
days.description: Requested duration; Vacation 100 means continuously on.
